 The product was delivered quickly. It was packaged nicely and all of the parts were in the box. The product was easy to assemble, lightweight, and cute. However, my disappointment begins with the long charging time. The mower only runs for thirty minutes, at best, on a full charge. It takes over two hours to fully charge the batteries. The constant need to stop, unhook the batteries, walk back to the charging ports, wait for the batteries to recharge, and plug the batteries back into the mower turned what is normally an hour and a half job into a six to seven hour nightmare. Additionally, it appears the batteries cannot tolerate hot weather because I had to wait over thirty minutes for the batteries to cool down before I could begin the changing process. Lastly, the mower’s cutting ability also falls short. This device is only good for maintaining small lawns that have already been tamed by prior cuttings. In short, I’m going to have to return this item.

 I think mine came with a bad battery because after the first time it wouldn’t charge beyond one bar, so this review is based on one use before I returned it. 
First the pros – I really like the design. It’s lightweight and so easy to maneuver. The handle on top is very handy for putting it in the car and moving it around. And the smaller footprint means it takes up less space in the garage. I really wish the mower had worked for us. 
Unfortunately, I just don’t think it’s powerful enough for a medium sized yard in the Pacific Northwest, where we often need to cut grass when it’s wet. Though our yard is within the size specified for the mower, I think this mower is best suited for small yards. Also, the handle must be gripped very tightly to keep the machine on, which could be an issue for anyone with less hand strength or other hand issues.
